shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a yellow shirt sits in the shelf-side window seat and asserts that saying what one means is the same as meaning what one says about solving the riddle, while a woman in a purple shirt sits in the doorway-side window seat and a woman in a red shirt sits in the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: The woman in the purple shirt tells the man in the yellow shirt that the two statements do not have the same meaning.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in the yellow shirt asks about the riddle rule, and the woman in the purple shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the game table.
